Preincubation of epitope-specific POM1 with PrP (23-230) blocked the neurodegeneration of cerebellar organotypic cultured slices (COCS) induced by POM1. Preincubation of POM1 scfv with PrP (23-230) also prevented cerebellar lesions induced by in vivo injection of POM1 into cerebella of WT or tga20 mice.

The epitope specific mAb VRQ14 recognized both infected and uninfected sheep brain homogenates in ELISA and immunoblot indicating that  VRQ14 interacted with cellular PrP<sup>C</sup> and pathological PrP<sup>Sc</sup> forms. Similar results were observed with the VRQ14 Fab fragment in competition ELISA. The mAb also interacted with normal or infected brain homogenates from mouse, hamster and macaque.
